entries.claim_boundary: The four-dimensional axial Ricci carrier has exact complete formal horizon and infinity bases on the ell=2 pilot interval, but the complete reconstructed metric basis is NOT_DEFINED: the imported two-row metric system omits delta Ric_{v phi}=p and contains a polynomial mode with exact nonzero omitted-row residual 3 i (omega-2 i)/r^2. No connection, flux, scattering or stability claim follows.

dispersion.statement: Carrier infinity rates are 0 and -2 i omega; horizon exponents are 0 (twice), -4 i omega and -2-4 i omega.

lee_wald.statement: The carrier basis has not yet been lifted to a complete metric basis on which endpoint flux could be defined.

resonance.statement: The order-two horizon resonance between the singular carrier branches has exact zero cokernel obstruction and forces no logarithm.

causal_retarded.statement: No global retarded problem is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No compact Taub map is involved.
